title: The Dinner Messenger
can_do: 把一个人的话准确带给另一个人，并把回话带回来。

conversation_move.label: carry a message between two people

trigger: Mom calls that dinner is ready, and Child becomes the messenger between the kitchen and Dad's study.
setting: Dinner time, between the kitchen and Dad's study.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I'm almost done fixing this lamp.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Daddy, Mom says dinner is ready.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Please tell her I'll come after one minute.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: She says the soup won't wait one minute!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Then tell Mom I'm coming right now.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: She says wash your hands first, then come.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Deal. Tell her I'm the fastest hand-washer.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom says dinner is on the table, come see!

replay_cards.title: The garden message
replay_cards.setting: Dad waters plants in the garden.
replay_cards.change: Mom calls that lunch is ready.
replay_cards.challenge: Child carries the message outside, brings Dad's answer back, and adds the wash-hands rule himself.

replay_cards.title: The doorbell message
replay_cards.setting: The neighbor drops by while Dad is upstairs.
replay_cards.change: She leaves a message about returning a ladder on Sunday.
replay_cards.challenge: Child delivers the message to Dad word-for-word and reports his answer back to Mom.

parent_support: 让孩子当真实的传话筒：真的把话带过去、把回话带回来。
传话走样时别急着纠正，问一句“妈妈原话是怎么说的”，让他自己修。
传完一轮可以玩“加一句”：允许孩子在消息里加自己的一句小提醒。
